items.title: Crossing cylinders
items.about: Union of two cylinders, r 20 mm, 100 mm long. The volume is 2πr²·100 − 16r³/3: their shared Steinmetz solid counts once.

items.title: Sphere with a hole
items.about: Sphere r 40 minus a cylinder r 10 along Z. What is left depends on the hole's height only: 4/3·π·(40² − 10²)^1.5.

items.title: Hole across the seam
items.about: Cylinder r 30 with a cross hole r 10 through the seam, the line where the cylinder's surface parameter wraps around.

items.title: Half torus
items.about: Torus R 60, r 15, cut in half by a box. Volume π²·60·15².

items.title: Truncated cone
items.about: Cone r 40, 90 mm high, cut at 45 mm. Volume of the frustum π·45/3·(40² + 40·20 + 20²).

items.title: Box with a cavity
items.about: A 60 mm cube minus a 20 mm cube inside it: two shells, the inner one facing into the hole.

items.title: Filleted box
items.about: 100 × 60 × 40 box with every edge rounded at r 15: rolling-ball blend faces.

items.title: Cushion
items.about: 400 × 400 × 100 box with edges rounded at r 47, nearly half its thickness.

items.title: Spring
items.about: Circle r 4 swept along a helix of radius 30 and height 120.

items.title: Square swept along a spline
items.about: 6 × 6 square swept along a 3D spline through four points.

items.title: Loft, circle to square
items.about: From a circle r 30 to a 40 × 40 square 100 mm above it.

items.title: Loft through three circles
items.about: Circles r 30, 15 and 25 at heights 0, 100 and 200.

items.title: Ring, revolved 120°
items.about: 20 × 20 rectangle 50 mm off the Y axis, revolved 120° about it. Volume a third of 2π·60·20·20.

items.title: Hollow tube bend
items.about: Ring r 12 / r 9 revolved 90° at radius 100.

items.title: Swept pipe
items.about: Circle r 5 swept along a polyline: 100 mm straight, a 90° arc of r 50, then straight again.

items.title: Lofted surface
items.about: Open surface lofted between two splines 80 mm apart. Open shapes have an area but no volume.

items.title: Swept surface
items.about: A 10 mm line swept along a 3D spline.

items.title: Revolved surface
items.about: A slanted line revolved 180°: half the side of a truncated cone. Area π·(50 + 70)·√800 / 2.

items.title: Region with two holes
items.about: 40 × 40 square minus two circles r 6. Area 1600 − 72π.

items.title: Wavy MESH
items.about: Ten-cell MESH (SubD), the last three cells wound the other way. They are turned to match their neighbours. A MESH is drawn as its unsmoothed cage.

items.title: Wavy polyface mesh
items.about: The same strip as a POLYLINE polyface mesh.

items.title: Wavy 3DFACEs
items.about: The same strip as ten separate 3DFACE entities.

items.title: Inside-out cube
items.about: 20 mm MESH cube with every face pointing inwards. The closed shell is turned outwards.

items.title: Mirrored wedge
items.about: A WEDGE mirrored with MIRROR3D. A mirroring transform turns faces inside out unless the triangles are rewound.

items.title: Block at scale −1, −1, −1
items.about: A block INSERT with all three scale factors negative.

items.title: Mirror in a nested block
items.about: A mirrored INSERT inside another block: one mirroring along the chain.

items.title: 1000 km from the origin
items.about: The sphere with a hole, moved 1 000 000 mm along each axis.

items.title: Tube bend, 1 km radius
items.about: A 90° tube bend scaled by 10 000.

items.title: Filleted box, 1 mm long
items.about: The filleted box at 1/100 scale. Parts thinner than 1 mm are checked by their extents only: the converter's 0.1 mm chord tolerance makes their area and volume meaningless.

groups.title: Written by gltf2dwg
groups.note: glTF files converted to DWG by this project's writer, then read back. They show the round trip, not how other programs write DWG.
